objective: Train D (degree-normalized scale-free memory, mixed patterns), Dr (same reads, rand only) and Dn (degree-normalized, no memory, mixed patterns) by OpenAI-ES, two seeds each; test with five runs per instance against widely re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT on held-out local and on the training families.
title: Degree-normalized scale-free memory trained on mixed meeting patterns, tested on a held-out one
